t: Modern SEO Techniques: AI's Are Intelligent
s: Modern SEO in the AI era emphasizes genuine value, storytelling, and becoming a memorable, surprising outlier to influence AI models.  Incumbent advantages in search persist, but new approaches focus on creating verifiable signal and becoming integral to AI's training data.
sub: AI as genuine intelligence impacting search filtering and ranking.
Value proposition and storytelling as core modern SEO strategies.
AI's ability to learn from surprising and evidence-based information.
The persistence of incumbent search infrastructure and advantages.
Leveraging surprise and differentiation to become a parameter in AI models.
